pii_policy: This file contains ZERO identity/content/PII. Partners are role codes only: A=Operator (ops/tech/marketing/finance), C=Creator (content). Never expand codes cross-domain. Outside this folder, refer to the project only as 'Project-F'.

hard_rules_locked: 1: feet-only — no face, no body, no explicit
2: full geo-block of Iran on every layer; no targeting users inside Iran; no geo-spoofing
3: in-platform payment only — never negotiate P2P/off-platform payment
4: no ToS violation on any platform
6: no city-level geo facts in public copy ('Aussie' only); Persian cultural signal visual-only, never textual
7: 'Project-F' code outside this folder; zero identity/content echo
8: 18+ with recorded consent; Creator's boundary (no body) is supreme over all plans
hard_rules_mutability: immutable without explicit human verdict. A master agent MUST NOT change, relax, or override any locked rule.

G0.condition: Branch A confirmed + signed 2-person agreement + Creator final-question re-ask

G1.condition: >=200 cumulative clicks AND >=10% click->follow AND Creator delivery-rate >=80%

G2.condition: >=30 free-subs AND >=5% free->paid AND first AUD 100 gross

G3.condition: >=AUD 2k/mo x3 months AND churn <30% -> ABN + licensed advisor

G4.condition: 12 months profitable + internal tool + proven distribution channel
